name: Gossamer Gingerbread
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Cream the butter, add sugar gradually, then egg well beaten.
Add milk, and dry ingredients mixed and sifted.
Spread in a buttered dripping-pan as thinly as possible, using the back of mixing-spoon.
Sprinkle with sugar, and cut in small squares or diamonds before removing from pan.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
